ios.desc:
Spin the rings. Match the colors. Clear the board.

Rotational is a fast, original color-matching puzzle. Blocks appear around the centre and fall outwards onto rings of color. Drag around the rings to turn them so each block lands next to its own color – every touching group of two or more disappears. Match again on your next drop to build your multiplier; miss and it resets.

DAILY PUZZLE
A new board every day, the same for every player in the world. Clear it as fast as you can, compare your time on the daily leaderboard and keep your streak going.

Share your result as a row of coloured dots – one for every move – without giving the board away.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• Daily Puzzle – one shared board a day (free)
• Continuous – endless play that speeds up every level (free)
• Calm – no clock: line up every drop at your own pace
• Puzzle – clear a packed board against the clock
• Time Attack – score as much as you can in 60 seconds

Calm, Puzzle and Time Attack unlock with one small purchase. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV – buy once, play on all four
• On Apple Watch, turn the Digital Crown to spin the rings, click by click
• On Apple TV, circle your thumb on the Siri Remote to spin the rings
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep your streak in view
• Game controller and keyboard support
• Plays offline – no Wi-Fi needed
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• Optional color-blind shapes on every block
• Haptics and the original sound effects

Rotational first launched in 2013. Version 2 is a complete rebuild for today's iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV, with the same simple, addictive rules.
